Questions partners ask
Do you work with other freight forwarders as agents?
Yes. Agency work with independent forwarders is how our business was built. We handle origin and destination in India, and nominate business to our partners in Latin America.
Which Indian ports and airports do you cover?
Our own teams are at Mundra, Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mumbai air cargo and Delhi (ICD Tughlakabad and other ICDs, and Delhi air cargo). We handle the rest of India through long-standing partners.
Can we communicate in Spanish or Portuguese?
Yes. Write to us in Spanish, Portuguese or English on WhatsApp or by email.
Which currency do you invoice in?
Usually US dollars for overseas partners; Indian rupees for Indian-side charges where required.
Can you help an importer find or check suppliers in India?
We handle the logistics and documentation side: supplier pickups, consolidation, pre-shipment document checks and export clearance. Tell us what you are buying and we will advise.
